description: This shell script provides functions related to preparing and upgrading firmware on Zyxel devices, including handling partition checks, rebooting on failures, and setting environment variables for boot configuration.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios during environment check or preparation, triggering a reboot.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for firmware upgrade by checking partitions, setting boot parameters, and managing boot partition switching.
